description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for performing BLS (Bureau of Labor Statistics) search operations, including query parameter definitions, data structures, and data extraction and transformation logic.

classes.name: BlsSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines the query parameters for BLS search, including category, include_extras, and include_code_map options.

classes.name: BlsSearchData
classes.description: Represents the data returned from a BLS search, with alias mappings for series_id and series_title.

classes.name: BlsSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing BLS search data, including transforming queries, extracting data from assets, and transforming data into structured results.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a BlsSearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Extracts data based on the query parameters, loading data assets, filtering by search terms, and handling errors.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw data into structured BlsSearchData objects and optionally includes code map metadata.
